::: {#exr-spider-mean-bolt}
On a graph of a function, what geometric quantity is the *rate of change* of the function with respect to its input? What is the name of the *function* that outputs that rate for every input?

```{mcq}
#| label: smb-1-lse
1. The rate of change is the *height* of the graph; the function that gives it is the *integral*.
2. The rate of change is the *slope* of the graph at that input; the function that gives the slope at every input is the *derivative*. [correct]
3. The rate of change is the *area* under the graph; the function is the *antiderivative*.
4. The rate of change is the *intercept*; the function is the *marginal* function.
```

:::
 <!-- end of exr-spider-mean-bolt -->
